what: Nexmark's 20 queries as Pondra views over 1M events on one node (tools/bench/nexmark.py --events 1000000 --engines pondra), all at once: secs is when the last view has its answer, sent_s when the last event was acknowledged. Runs of a view that runs its query again (q4, q5, q8, q9, q18, q19) are paced by what they took; before, that counted their waits for the lake's lock (held by tiering for seconds) and for their commit, so a run behind a tiering round waited ten times that again.
summary: every answer in 7.3–10.5 s (mean 9.1) instead of 9.1–28.6 s (mean 17.5); ingest no slower (sent 2.4–3.6 s against 3.8–4.9 s); every view == DuckDB's answer in every run
